meta.name: prompt-master
meta.description: Generates optimized prompts for AI tools. Activates only when the user explicitly asks to write, fix, improve, or adapt a prompt for a specific AI tool (LLM, Cursor, Midjourney, image AI, video AI, coding agents, etc.). Does not activate for general conversation, coding tasks, document writing, or other non-prompt-engineering work.

copy.tagline: 为AI工具生成优化提示词
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常需要为不同AI工具编写或改进提示词
copy.tagline_en: Generate optimized prompts for AI tools
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often write or improve prompts for various AI tools

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，当你要求写、修改或优化某个AI工具的提示词时，Claude会变成提示词工程师，输出一条可直接粘贴的提示词，不包含理论解释。
howto.when: 当你明确要求为特定AI工具（如LLM、Cursor、Midjourney等）编写、修复、改进或适配提示词时触发。普通对话、编程、文档写作等不会触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个给Midjourney生成赛博朋克城市景观的提示词。
say.note: Claude会输出一条针对Midjourney优化的提示词。

say.text: 优化这条提示词，让它更适合Claude Code：'重构登录模块'。
say.note: Claude会分析目标工具并输出改进后的提示词。

say.text: 把这段描述改写成适合ChatGPT的提示词，要求输出JSON格式。
say.note: Claude会按ChatGPT的规则生成结构化提示词。

howto.what_en: When installed, if you ask to write, fix, improve, or adapt a prompt for a specific AI tool, Claude acts as a prompt engineer and outputs a single copyable prompt block without explanations.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask to write, fix, improve, or adapt a prompt for a specific AI tool (e.g., LLM, Cursor, Midjourney). Does not activate for general conversation, coding, or document writing.

say_en.text: Write a prompt for Midjourney to generate a cyberpunk cityscape.
say_en.note: Claude outputs a prompt optimized for Midjourney.

say_en.text: Optimize this prompt for Claude Code: 'Refactor the login module'.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes the target tool and outputs an improved prompt.

say_en.text: Rewrite this description as a prompt for ChatGPT, output JSON format.
say_en.note: Claude generates a structured prompt following ChatGPT rules.
